violation_type.title: Toddler Care Area - Allows for Proper Supervision (26 TAC §746.2503(2))
violation_type.short_title: Toddler Care Area - Allows for Proper Supervision
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and was deficient. The operation allowed children access to an area that limited their supervision.

finding_variants.text: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and was deficient. The operation allowed children access to an area that limited their supervision.
A child was left in the classroom for less than five minutes as the rest of the children were doing their outside time.

Based on DFPS investigation there is enough evidence to validate that a child had access to medication from provider's purse prior to this follow up. Staff now has to acknowledge that there will be no hazardous materials accessible to children.

A child was bitten multiple times by another child while the caregiver changed a diaper.  Due to the layout of the toddler/two-year-old classroom, an additional caregiver in the classroom during diaper changes was also necessary for adequate supervision.
